reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a GIVING file (file-name-4) has only fixed length records, each merged record shorter than that fixed length must be written to it space filled on the right from the position after its last character, for every organization of file-name-4 and for each of several GIVING files; a variable-length GIVING file instead receives the record at its own size (GR11b).
reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, CobolVersion, DialectBehavior, IsActive, Constructs in SortEmitter.cs (EmitInputFile, EmitGivingFile), CobolSort.cs (FillTo, Release), RecordFill.cs and FileModel.cs (ShortRecordFillNational, RecordSizeVaries, RecordWidth): none consults the edition; the fill is one code path for every edition. The only edition-dependent input is whether the file is fixed length, decided by the RECORD clause binding (format 3 is variable at every edition, docs/conformance DOC-A.1-148).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf33_02 covers a variable-length SD into one fixed sequential GIVING file; not exercised are a fixed SD shorter than the GIVING file, relative and indexed GIVING files, several GIVING files, and a variable GIVING file beside the fixed ones.
